notes: Strip f of plate 22-67 (x 7930-9910). The plate's north edge is cut along Hewitt Avenue's north side; the right edge is cut along Wold Avenue's east side, so the stubs of Hewitt/Kinney/Fairfax/Dexter east of Wold and the stubs north of Hewitt and Madison are short paper tabs with partial names. Several solid lines inside streets are pipes/sewers, not street edges. 'PRIVATE DRIVE' (printed, ~24 ft) runs from the west corner of Keys Crescent (~7975,4690) south to Taft Street (~7990,6110); left out of intersections as a private lane. The bottom street is labelled 'TAFT' near x 6100 and 'ST.' near x 9130; recorded as Taft Street. Wold Avenue is labelled 'AVE.' near y 1000 and 'WOLD' near y 3600. Fairfield Avenue (x~7530-7560) and the street at x~7490 lie just outside this strip's 300 px overlap and are not picked.
